name: sponTRIP
description: SponTRIP monorepo — Expo mobile client, Astro web surface, Supabase backend, CI mechanical-check scripts.
//engines: Two Node majors are genuinely supported across this monorepo, not one
(decision 130): apps/mobile and ci/scripts need Node 20 LTS; apps/web
needs Node >=22.12.0 (see apps/web/package.json's own engines field and
apps/web/.nvmrc) because astro@7.2.9 requires it to clear HIGH/CRITICAL
npm-audit advisories unfixable on astro@5.x. Root's own engines field
matters because `npm ci` at the repo root - which installs every
workspace's deps together via the shared lockfile - runs under BOTH
versions depending on which CI job invoked it (see .github/workflows/
ci.yml's web-node22 job vs every other job). A single 20-only range
here produced a benign but noisy EBADENGINE warning on every Node-22
job; this range reflects reality instead.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile && npm run typecheck -w ci/scripts && node -e "console.log('NOTE: apps/web needs Node 22, see apps/web/.nvmrc (decision 130). Switch Node then run: npm run typecheck:web')"
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/mobile && npm run test -w ci/scripts && node -e "console.log('NOTE: apps/web needs Node 22, see apps/web/.nvmrc (decision 130). Switch Node then run: npm run test:web')"
